jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
IDR is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join one of our top clients for a remote + travel opportunity.
This role involves leading the planning, execution, and delivery of complex projects within a dynamic, technology-driven environment. The company is a leader in the IT and technology consulting industry, focusing on innovative solutions and client success.

Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of multiple medium-to-large, complex projects from initiation through closure.

Maintain accountability for project documentation, reporting, invoicing, client sign-offs, and overall project governance throughout the project lifecycle.
Mentor and coach Project Managers and Coordinators, driving continuous improvement, project recovery efforts, and best-practice adoption across the organization.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Bridges
jobs.description:
Are you ambitious and looking to make the right move in your career? Now is the perfect time to join Egis. Egis is experiencing substantial growth in North America, now made up of over 1,000 engineers, architects and planners across Canada and the USA. This strategic move underscores our commitment to investing in North America, propelling our expansion to new heights.

Job Description

The Project Manager – Bridges is responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing bridge design and inspection projects from initiation to completion. This role ensures projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, regulatory, and quality standards. The role also includes assisting with proposal development and submissions for bridge projects.

Project Planning & Execution

Manage all phases of multi-disciplinary bridge design projects.
Develop detailed project schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
Coordinate with design teams, consultants, contractors, and government agencies.
Ensure compliance with technical specifications and engineering standards.

Budget & Cost Control

Prepare and monitor project budgets.
Manage change orders.
Complete project invoices and track sub consultant payments

Contract & Stakeholder Management

Administer contracts and ensure contractual obligations are met.
Conduct progress meetings with clients, contractors, and stakeholders.
Maintain effective communication with regulatory authorities.
Resolve disputes and technical challenges.

Risk & Quality Management

Identify and mitigate project risks.
Ensure quality control and adherence to safety standards.
Conduct site inspections and audits.
Implement corrective actions when required.

Safety & Compliance

Ensure compliance with OSHA/local safety regulations.
Promote a strong safety culture on site.
Review and approve safety plans and method statements.

Reporting

Prepare regular progress reports.
Provide updates to senior management.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering
Professional Engineer (PE) license (preferred/required depending on region).
6-10 years of experience.
Proven experience managing projects.
Strong knowledge of structural engineering principles.
Familiarity with CHBDC, AASHTO, ASTM, and relevant local standards.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

This role is eligible for a referral bonus in line with the Referral Program. If you have been referred, please provide the name of the employee who has referred you at the time of your application.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

Job Description

The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of Salesforce transformation and optimization initiatives within the pharmaceutical industry. The role focuses on Salesforce org simplification, third-party system rationalization, and digital communication platform enhancements to support enterprise digital transformation. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and architects, the Project Manager ensures successful project execution, effective risk management, and the delivery of scalable, streamlined digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end delivery of Salesforce transformation projects, including org simplification, system consolidation, and platform optimization initiatives.
Manage projects focused on simplifying Salesforce integrations with third-party applications and reducing application landscape complexity.
Drive continuous enhancement of digital communication platforms and related business capabilities.
Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocation, risks, and dependencies.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across Business, IT, Salesforce, Architecture, and external vendors.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment, governance meetings, status reporting, and executive communications.
Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and align with business, compliance, and technology objectives.
Support enterprise digital transformation by promoting standardized processes, scalable solutions, and improved system architecture.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience managing enterprise IT projects, preferably within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industries.
Proven experience delivering Salesforce-related projects, including Salesforce CRM implementations, enhancements, or transformation initiatives.
Strong understanding of Salesforce multi-org architectures, integration patterns, and system simplification methodologies.
Experience managing third-party system integrations and application rationalization initiatives.
Basic understanding of enterprise digital communication platforms and related business processes.
Proficiency in Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
Strong stakeholder management, project governance, risk management, and communication skills.

Additional Information

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:

At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Growth & Development

Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.

jobs.description:
About Us

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

Our Mission

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

As a Project Manager at Opensity Solutions, you will serve as the single point of accountability to the client for project outcomes. You will own the client relationship, scope, commitments, and overall success of assigned projects — including infrastructure upgrades, client onboarding, acquisitions, and ServiceNow development. This role requires strong client relationship management, strategic project leadership, and exceptional communication skills to drive cross-functional teams toward successful, on-time, and on-budget delivery.

Job type
: Full time/Permanent

Location:
Remote in Ontario/Alberta

Compensation:
CAD 100,000- 110,000 per annum

Roles & Responsibilities 

Responsibilities for this role include, but may not be limited to, the following: 

Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as primary client contact and relationship owner, acting as the single voice to the client. 
Lead all client meetings, workshops, steering committees, and governance forums. 
Manage client expectations regarding scope, timeline, risks, and deliverables. 
Communicate status, risks, issues, and change requests clearly and proactively. 
Own executive-level escalations and drive resolutions with urgency and transparency. 

Scope, Planning & Decision Ownership 

Own project scope, objectives, and success criteria in alignment with client and organizational strategy. 
Maintain the master project plan and milestone commitments, confirming priorities with the client. 
Approve priorities, sequencing, and trade-off decisions that impact delivery timelines or scope. 
Own and enforce change control processes, including change order negotiations with the client. 
Hold final approval authority for all deliverables prior to client submission. 

Governance, Reporting & Risk Management 

Own the final status reporting delivered to the client, including messaging around delays or risks. 
Prepare, review, edit, and contextualize delivery metrics, RIDAC logs, and forecasts. 
Decide mitigation strategies for delivery risks and issue. 
Manage executive-level escalations and ensure compliance with PMO standards and governance requirements. 

Financial & Commercial Management 

Own project budget, forecasts, and overall financial performance. 
Approve invoicing inputs and track commercial health of assigned projects. 
Lead change order discussions and client negotiations for scope or cost adjustments. 
Ensure contract compliance across all project deliverables. 

Knowledge, Skills & Attributes 

Proven ability to lead and deliver technology projects in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
Strong client relationship management and communication skills with a track record of high client satisfaction. 
Expertise in project planning, risk management, and cross-functional team leadership. 
Business acumen with the ability to align project outcomes to organizational strategy. 
Proficiency in communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
Experience managing projects with distributed and offshore/nearshore delivery teams. 
Strong financial and commercial management skills, including budgeting, forecasting, and change order negotiation. 
High ethical standards and commitment to confidentiality and data security. 
Dedication to K2 Values: Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, Innovation, Service Orientation. 
Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. 

Qualifications  & Requirements

5+ years of technical project delivery experience with direct client-facing responsibility. 

Experience leading implementations of general technology services, including but not limited to:

Microsoft Enterprise Infrastructure Solutions (Azure, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, etc.) 
Document Management Systems (iManage, NetDocuments, etc.) 
Virtualization Platforms (VMware, Nutanix, etc.) 
Data Storage, Backup, and Disaster Recovery 
Security Operations and Compliance (SOC2, ISO audits, etc.) 
Datacenter migration, circuits installation 
Enterprise and Solution Integration 
Firm merger and acquisition integration.
Experience managing projects with offshore/nearshore delivery teams and structured handoff cadences across time zones. 

Education 

Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field required. 

Credentials / Certifications 

PMP certification preferred. 
Agile certification (e.g., Scrum Master) a plus. 
ITIL certification a plus.

Right across infrastructure, there’s a requirement to not only maintain, but also renew and reimagine. Whatever stage you’re at in your career; with us you’ll have an opportunity to grow and develop. Delivering essential infrastructure services for life, while being safety first, and client and customer centric in a friendly, fun and respectful environment where you are encouraged to thrive.

Where you’ll be working?

BGEN is one of the UK's largest multidisciplinary design and build contractors with over 100 years of industry experience. We support clients in the Water, Power & Energy, Pharmaceutical, Nuclear and Food and Beverage industries to deliver next generation, value-added engineering solutions.

What you'll be doing?

BGEN are looking for an enthusiastic Project Manager with a can-do attitude to support their project in Cambridge. The project is a multidisciplinary contract E& I & Mechanical scopes.

The Project Manager reporting directly to the Project Director provides leadership to the site teams and is responsible for, scheduling, workface planning, coordinating, supervising, assisting in cost control and ensuring the safety, productivity of the teams at the workface including site installations and associated cabling installs. The role also involves planning and scheduling work activities to achieve project objectives, ensuring labour, materials, tools, and work packages are available and coordinated. The Project Manager works closely with other trades and stakeholders to avoid conflicts and maintain productivity. Quality control is achieved by ensuring work complies with specifications, drawings, and inspection requirements. Additionally, the Project Manager oversees project administration, including reporting progress, maintaining records, approving material requisitions, and recommending personnel actions to support successful project outcomes.

You will bring:

Mechanical / Electrical Degree / HND / HNC or relevant experience
Professional Registration desirable (Chartered or Member)

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join us and be a part of our collaborative company culture, providing innovative, quality-built construction projects as a leading retail general contractor throughout California and the western United States.

We are looking for a Project Manager who will facilitate and manage construction projects from start to finish with precision and thoroughness, ensuring jobs are completed on schedule and within budget, with a strong team attitude to ensure a successful project outcome.

Keep Reading IF

YOU ARE SELF DRIVEN AND PROACTIVE. You can take full ownership of a project from start to finish, from buyout to close. You can work autonomously with a high degree of follow-through to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

YOU ARE A PROBLEM SOLVER AND TEAM PLAYER. You enjoy turning challenges and obstacles into opportunities, finding a solution while maintaining a positive attitude with results driven mentality. You understand the importance of collaboration with all construction team members, Project Engineers, Field Supervisors, Subcontractors, and Clients, showing a commitment to manage projects effectively.

YOU ARE A MULTI-TASKER AND HIGHLY ORGANIZED. You can effectively manage multiple projects at a time, being pulled in multiple directions, and can prioritize urgent matters as they arise.

Essential Duties May Include

In the first 30 days and ongoing:

Learn Eleven Western Builders services, processes and procedures, and business lines.
Attend meetings with Project Managers to understand how to run onsite meetings.
Learn the buyout process; reviewing the bid book of all proposals and plans, contracting trades to accomplish the project, contacting the Construction Manager for the client to understand permits, determining the feasibility of a schedule, and determining the onsite date for the Field team once everything is in place for the project to begin.
Learn project management software, i.e., Timberline Sage program, and ProCore.
Build positive working relationships with Project Engineers, Field Superintendents, General Superintendents, Subcontractors, Accounting team, Contract Administrator, Project Managers, and Leadership.

By The 90-day Mark And Ongoing

Begin managing smaller projects, from start to finish, working closely with other Project Managers and the President, absorbing and retaining as much information as possible about how to run a successful project.
Has a foundational understanding of the buyout process to drive the start of a project.
Understand how to put the budget together and work closely with the Project Superintendent to ensure the project is on schedule.
Work directly with subcontractors on any change orders or CCD’s, request change proposals, or work out a T&M based change/ work order.
Partner with Project Engineers and Accounting team for the closeout, ensuring all the paperwork is complete to bill for final retention.
Throughout each project, proactively communicate with the client with project updates and any issues.

Within The 6th To 9th-month Mark And Ongoing

Fully understand the project management process, and is running projects on their own, asking questions as needed.
Can manage difficult situations when necessary, such as sending a 48-hour notice to a subcontractor and supplementing if a subcontractor is not performing, in a respectful and professional manner.
Problem-solve in fast-paced environments, and maintain a professional and positive attitude.

By The 12th Month Mark And Ongoing

Is a fully integrated member of the team, able to consistently and proactively managing multiple projects from start to finish independently.
Bring projects to completion on schedule and under budget, troubleshooting issues with professionalism and poise.
Exhibit a positive attitude and drive when working on all projects, simple or complex, working to deliver the best outcome for our clients.

Education, Skills & Experience

5+ years of project management experience in the retail and/or fast food construction industry required
Must be able to read and understand project plans and specifications
Knowledge of general contracting and sub-contracting process, how to construct a building, terms, methods, and scheduling

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Blooming Health

Blooming Health is on a mission to transform social care! Our AI-powered platform identifies social needs and barriers by continuously collecting real-time data from member interactions and screenings. It then drives action through automated, empathetic outreach in 55+ languages/dialects to engage individuals across voice, SMS, and email, and coordinating referrals to the right services at the right time. The result is improved access to care, higher program participation, and better outcomes across diverse populations. Our platform supports 1,000+ community organizations across the US, helping millions of members access the support they need to stay healthy. We don’t just offer software—we deliver impact.

About The Role

As we scale, we’re looking for a highly driven and technically sophisticated Senior Technical Program Manager to own delivery execution across Blooming Health’s Engineering, AI, and Product organizations. This is a US-based remote role with preference for working on EST or CST hours.

This Senior TPM will serve as the operational backbone of the product development organization, ensuring critical initiatives are delivered on time, dependencies are managed proactively, and leadership has complete visibility into roadmap progress, customer implementations, and organizational priorities. While Engineering and Product leaders define strategy, architecture, and roadmap direction, this role is responsible for driving execution, accountability, and delivery outcomes across the organization.

This is not a project coordinator or ticket-tracking role. We are looking for someone who can operate as a force multiplier for leadership—someone who understands complex technical systems, thrives in ambiguity, navigates competing priorities, and creates structure where none exists. The ideal candidate combines strong program management expertise, technical credibility, startup execution experience, and exceptional communication skills.

What You'll Do

Engineering Delivery Leadership:
Own the end-to-end delivery process across Engineering, AI, and Product teams. Drive sprint planning, backlog management, dependency tracking, roadmap execution, and delivery accountability across multiple concurrent initiatives.

Program Execution & Accountability:
Establish and enforce operating rhythms, delivery processes, and accountability frameworks that ensure teams consistently meet commitments and execution risks are surfaced early.

Cross-Functional Coordination:
Partner closely with Engineering, AI, Product, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, and ensure critical information flows effectively across the organization.

Customer Deployment Oversight:
Coordinate delivery across multiple concurrent customer implementations, balancing customer commitments, product priorities, and engineering capacity while proactively identifying risks and resource conflicts.

Risk Management & Escalation:
Identify blockers, timeline risks, resource constraints, and delivery challenges before they become critical issues. Facilitate decision-making and drive resolution across teams and stakeholders.

Executive Reporting & Visibility:
Serve as the central source of truth for delivery status across the organization. Provide clear, concise, executive-ready updates on roadmap progress, customer deployments, risks, dependencies, and organizational priorities.

Technical Program Leadership:
Participate in technical discussions and architecture reviews to understand delivery implications, identify dependencies, and support informed prioritization decisions across complex systems.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement:
Build scalable program management processes that improve organizational effectiveness without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. Continuously evolve delivery frameworks as the company grows and product complexity increases.

What We're Looking For

Requirements

Technical Program Management Expertise: 10+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Operations, or related delivery-focused leadership roles.
Startup & Growth-Stage Experience: Proven success operating within fast-paced startup environments, ideally helping organizations scale from early product-market fit through rapid customer growth and organizational expansion.
Complex Technical Delivery Experience: Demonstrated experience managing technically sophisticated initiatives involving distributed systems, AI/ML platforms, cloud-native architectures, customer-facing products, or other highly complex software environments.
AI/ML or Agentic Systems Experience: Experience supporting AI, machine learning, agentic systems, or similarly complex and iterative technology development environments where delivery timelines and success metrics are less deterministic than traditional software development.
Strong SDLC & Program Management Foundations: Deep understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern software development lifecycle practices. Ability to apply process thoughtfully based on organizational needs rather than rigid adherence to methodology.
Technical Credibility: Comfortable participating in discussions involving architecture, infrastructure, system design, APIs, data flows, cloud platforms, and engineering tradeoffs. Able to understand delivery implications of technical decisions without serving as the technical decision-maker.
Stakeholder Management & Influence: Exceptional ability to influence senior leaders, engineers, product managers, and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority. Comfortable holding teams accountable and facilitating difficult prioritization conversations.
Executive Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Able to deliver concise status updates, facilitate executive discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and translate technical complexity into business context.
Multi-Workstream Program Leadership: Proven track record managing multiple concurrent projects competing for shared engineering resources while maintaining delivery momentum and organizational alignment.
Self-Starter Mentality: Highly proactive and capable of establishing structure, processes, and operating rhythms in ambiguous environments with limited guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare Technology Experience: Experience working within healthcare technology, health plans, provider organizations, HIPAA-regulated environments, or other highly regulated industries.
Voice AI & Conversational Systems: Direct experience supporting voice AI platforms, conversational agents, agentic systems, real-time communication platforms, or customer-facing AI products.
Cloud & Infrastructure Knowledge: Familiarity with cloud-native environments, particularly GCP or AWS, along with modern distributed application architectures and observability practices.
Technical Background: Prior experience as a software engineer, solutions architect, technical lead, or other technical role is highly desirable.
Customer-Facing Delivery Experience: Experience managing customer implementations, enterprise software deployments, or customer-facing technical programs where contractual commitments and delivery timelines are critical.
Project Management Platforms: Experience using Linear, Jira, or similar work management tools to coordinate delivery across multiple teams and complex roadmaps.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that succeeds through influence, disciplined communication, and data rather than direct authority. The Program Manager works directly with product owners and cross-functional project teams to keep high-stakes initiatives on track, and gives leadership a real-time, honest picture of progress across the organization's most important product bets.

What You'll Do

Manage and Report on Key Strategic Initiatives

Manage and support key large-scale product projects. Actively manage progress on the organization's strategic product initiatives including product modernization, AI/ML integration, and other transformational, multi-quarter projects as examples, partnering closely with product owners and project teams to keep work moving against plan.
Own status reporting to leadership. Build and maintain accurate, timely, executive-ready status reports and dashboards for key projects, giving leadership a clear, consolidated view of progress, milestones, budget/resourcing status, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.
Track project health and key metrics. Define and monitor the milestones, KPIs, and success metrics for each large-scale initiative, translating detailed project activity into concise, decision-ready insight for leadership and flagging projects that are off track.

Keep Initiatives On Track

Identify and escalate risks and issues. Proactively identify risks, issues, blockers, and cross-team dependencies threatening a project's scope, schedule, or quality; maintain a clear view of open items and escalate to leadership with recommended paths forward.
Run project governance and cadence. Establish and facilitate a regular cadence of project reviews and checkpoints with project teams and leadership ensuring each key initiative has a consistent forum for reporting progress, making decisions, and resolving blockers.
Drive accountability across project teams. Hold project owners and cross-functional contributors (engineering, design, product marketing, product management, sales, customer success) accountable to committed timelines and deliverables, following up on action items and unresolved issues between checkpoints.

Communicate and Support Decision-Making

Communicate with stakeholders. Tailor communication of project status and impact for different audiences, from individual project teams to senior executives, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned throughout each initiative's lifecycle.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
Program Manager II, El Nino Preparedness South America – EMPOWER/RAPID
jobs.description:
Job Summary

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Program Manager II will provide time-bound program management, technical support, accompaniment, and training to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response. The position will coordinate preparedness programming across priority countries and hotspots, translating hazard, vulnerability, market, operational, and partner-capacity analysis into practical readiness actions, quality program designs, and activation-ready response plans.

Working closely with the Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II and other technical and operational colleagues, the Program Manager II will align program strategies, targeting, transfer modalities, technical standards, MEAL, accountability, safeguarding, protection, and partner capacity strengthening with sourcing, contracting, logistics, cash and voucher assistance, and distribution readiness. The role will help partners identify and close priority program bottlenecks, test readiness arrangements, and maintain an integrated package that can be rapidly adapted when an EMPOWER/RAPID response is activated.

Roles And Key Responsibilities

Lead the programmatic El Niño preparedness process across South America priority countries in close coordination with EMPOWER partners, country program or program office teams, RAPID counterparts, technical advisors, MEAL, and supply chain and operations colleagues.
Develop and maintain an integrated assignment workplan and deliverable calendar that links program, MEAL, partnership, cash and voucher assistance, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operational readiness activities.
Coordinate hazard, vulnerability, exposure, seasonal, and scenario analysis to identify priority countries, hotspots, population groups, likely needs, access constraints, and preparedness triggers for drought, floods, food insecurity, wildfires and related El Niño impacts.
Lead stakeholder and service mapping with partners, including government authorities, Caritas structures, humanitarian coordination bodies, community actors, technical services, financial service providers, and other response stakeholders.
Support partners to develop or update country- and hotspot-specific contingency plans, response strategies, sector and modality options, targeting approaches, geographic priorities, and scalable response scenarios.
Work with sector technical leads and partners to define minimum program quality standards, intervention packages, eligibility and prioritization criteria, transfer values or assistance quantities, referral pathways, and safe adaptation or substitution rules.
Coordinate with the Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II to validate proposed relief kits, in-kind assistance, and cash or voucher options against assessed needs, local market capacity, cultural appropriateness, protection considerations, delivery feasibility, lead times, and cost drivers.
Integrate market and logistics findings into program design, including modality selection, remote-area feasibility, delivery sequencing, contingency options, and realistic procurement and implementation timelines.
Support partner readiness for cash and voucher assistance by defining program requirements for geographic coverage, transfer modalities, participant data, accountability, complaints handling, protection, inclusion, reconciliation, monitoring, and failed-payment follow-up in coordination with operations and finance teams.
Lead development of activation-ready program packages, including concise needs assessment tools, rapid response concepts, targeting and registration approaches, implementation plans, staffing assumptions, budgets, procurement inputs, risk assessments, and donor-ready narrative components.
Provide management, guidance, and technical oversight throughout preparedness and any activated response cycle so that design, start-up, implementation, monitoring, adaptation, and close-out align with CRS program quality principles and standards, donor requirements, and humanitarian best practice.
Collaborate with MEAL and information management colleagues to establish preparedness indicators where feasible, baseline or reference data, data-collection and analysis tools, monitoring plans, feedback and response mechanisms, and learning questions.
Ensure that safeguarding, protection mainstreaming, gender, age, disability inclusion, accountability to affected populations, conflict sensitivity, and disaster risk reduction are integrated across assessments, designs, partner tools, simulations, and readiness plans.
Assess partner program-management and technical readiness; facilitate participatory prioritization and partner-specific action plans with clear actions, responsible persons, deadlines, support needs, approvals, risks, contingencies, escalation points, and maintenance responsibilities.
Design and facilitate coaching, working sessions, simulations, tabletop exercises, or readiness tests so partner teams can practice assessment, decision-making, coordination, modality selection, activation, implementation, monitoring, adaptation, and reporting.
Contribute to partner capacity strengthening through tailored learning strategies, agendas and curricula, workshops, mentoring, and coaching based on priorities identified by partners.
Support quality donor engagement and resource mobilization by contributing technical analysis, program design, proposal writing, budgeting, staffing plans, and donor discussions for El Niño preparedness and rapid response opportunities.
Promote strong, equitable partnerships in line with CRS and Caritas Internationalis partnership principles and facilitate timely resolution of programmatic or coordination challenges through dialogue and appropriate support.
Contribute to knowledge management by documenting decisions, lessons, tested approaches, readiness gaps, good practices, and recommendations that can inform EMPOWER/RAPID programming in South America and other regions.
Consolidate and hand over the final El Niño program preparedness package, including analyses, contingency and response plans, assessment and design tools, MEAL materials, partner action plans, training resources, ownership arrangements, maintenance recommendations, and an exit debrief.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong program management and technical skills across emergency preparedness, rapid needs assessment, response design, contingency planning, implementation, monitoring, adaptation, and close-out.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to synthesize hazard, vulnerability, market, operational, and partner information into prioritized, realistic actions.
Good grants management and budgeting experience, including design and proposal development for public or institutional donors.
MEAL and information-management skills, including development of practical indicators, data-collection tools, analysis approaches, feedback mechanisms, and reporting products. Experience with KoboToolbox, CommCare, or similar tools is desirable.
Ability to facilitate partner-led processes, build trust, adapt technical support to partner priorities, and promote sustainable ownership of preparedness systems.
Excellent planning, coordination, documentation, facilitation, presentation, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliverables across countries.
Strong relationship-management and professional communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with partner leadership, technical teams, donors, government, and internal support functions.
Proactive, resourceful, culturally sensitive, solution-oriented, and results-focused.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, web-conferencing platforms, and common information-management systems.

Required Languages:
Professional fluency in English and Spanish is required. Professional proficiency in Portuguese is strongly preferred; French is an advantage for engagement across target regions.

Travel:
The assignment will be primarily remote, with in-country or regional travel to priority partners, countries, or hotspots as approved and operationally required. The selected candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 50 percent within South America and work effectively across time zones and in diverse operating environments.

Supervisory Responsibility:
No

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in international development, international relations, humanitarian response, disaster risk management, food security, public health, social sciences, or a related field.
Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in humanitarian program management, emergency preparedness and response, or related technical programming, including field-based experience and work on complex or rapid-onset emergencies.
Experience managing moderately complex projects, preferably with an international NGO, across multiple countries or dispersed geographic areas.
Demonstrated experience translating assessments and scenario analysis into response strategies, quality program designs, implementation plans, and budgets.
Previous experience providing technical assistance, strengthening local partner capacity, and developing successful proposals for external donor funding.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in international development, international relations, humanitarian response, disaster risk management, food security, public health, social sciences, or a related field.
Knowledge of humanitarian principles, standards, coordination systems, and emergency program quality requirements; knowledge of CRS and Caritas Internationalis programming and standards.
Experience with El Niño, drought, flood, wildfires, food security, cash and voucher assistance, multipurpose cash, WASH, shelter, protection, or other relevant preparedness and response programming.
Experience with market-based programming and coordination between program, MEAL, supply chain, finance, operations, safeguarding, and compliance functions.
Experience working with Caritas organizations, faith-based partners, or other local humanitarian actors.
Experience operating in insecure, remote, or access-constrained environments.
Experience working in South America.

Agency Competencies (for All CRS Staff)

Personal Accountability – Consistently takes responsibility for one’s own actions.
Acts with Integrity - Consistently models values aligned with CRS Guiding Principles and mission. Is considered honest.
Builds and Maintains Trust - Shows consistency between words and actions.
Collaborates with Others – Works effectively in intercultural and diverse teams.
Open to Learn – Seeks out experiences that may change perspective or provide an opportunity to learn new things.

Agency Leadership Competencies

Lead Change – Continually looks for ways to improve the agency through a culture of agility, openness, and innovation.
Develops and Recognizes Others – Builds the capacity of staff to reach their full potential and enhance team and agency performance.
Strategic Mindset – Understands role in translating, communicating, and implementing agency strateg y and team priorities.

What We Offer

CRS offers U.S. based staff a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, life insurance, vision, and a generous retirement savings plan. Benefits packages for successful candidates employed outside the U.S. are based on the country of employment/in-country office where the candidate will perform the role. CRS´ work culture is a collaborative, mission-driven culture committed to improving the lives of the poor throughout the world.

About Us

Catholic Relief Services is the official international humanitarian agency of the Catholic community in the United States. Catholic Relief Services works to save, protect, and transform lives in need in more than 100 countries,

Strong expertise in Medicaid and Medicare programs, regulations, and managed care operations
Expertise in population health strategies, value-based care, and quality improvement
Advanced knowledge in quality improvement methodologies and health care performance metrics (HEDIS, NCQA, CMS Star Rating, CCO Metrics)
Expertise in program design, implementation, and monitoring
Knowledge of healthcare delivery systems, care management operations, social determinants of health, and community resources

Skills And Abilities

Proven ability to lead through influence, facilitate cross-functional decision-making, and drive accountability for deliverables
Proficiency in interpreting and analyzing healthcare data from dashboards and reports (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Excel, or similar tools)
Advanced Excel functions for manipulating, analyzing, and visualizing population and claims data to inform data-driven decision-making and actionable recommendations
Experience in program evaluation, cost analysis, and identifying trends in healthcare utilization
Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to oversee large-scale initiatives
Excellent project management skills, including experience with Agile methodologies and performance tracking
Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with healthcare providers, community organizations, and government agencies
Effective communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Experience with quality improvement methodologies and other process optimization frameworks

Experience developing policies/procedures, facilitating governance forums, or managing vendors/contracts
Ability to work effectively with diverse individuals and groups
Ability to learn, focus, understand, and evaluate information and determine appropriate actions
Ability to accept direction and feedback, as well as tolerate and manage stress

Ability to hear and speak clearly for at least 3-6 hours/day

jobs.description:
At GFiber, we believe that great internet has the power to drive innovation, strengthen communities, enable the impossible, and do all the everyday things that make all of our world go round. And the job of creating better internet is never done - so we’re growing! Our team is committed to building a place where people who want to make a difference can grow their careers and find their spot to belong.

GFiber is an Alphabet company that brings Google Fiber and Google Fiber Webpass internet services to homes and businesses across the United States. Our teams are expanding as we connect more cities and people to exceptional internet.

The application window will be open until at least September 14th, 2026
. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Role Description:

The PgM Lead will manage a team of program managers to ensure schedules are met and critical projects are delivered. These projects will span engineering, operations, construction, budgets, forecasting and planning. The PgM Lead is tasked with ensuring the team executes against strategic priorities set by leadership. The ideal candidate mixes tenacity, organizational skills, strong communication and leadership. This role requires prioritizing tasks, managing a complex schedule, ensuring deliverables are met across multiple work streams and being an effective cross functional leader. The PgM Lead works across the organization to refine and evolve our projects, as well as deploy new technologies to markets and communities throughout the market(s).

In this role you’ll:

Management functions to include aspects of project initiation, planning, executing, controlling, and closing.
Operate across internal Google Fiber groups and external organizations to ready and implement operational processes.
Lead process improvements that result in efficiency and efficacy gains throughout deployment and operations in the market(s).
Execute multiple projects/programs/planning in support of long term success
Manage full time employees and delivery of projects through strategic partners/vendors.

At a minimum, we would like you to have:

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Telecommunications or a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in successfully managing a complex schedule with a diverse vendor base, leading annual planning cycles, developing and managing contracts, invoicing, budgeting, forecasting, project reporting (costs, status and risks), procurement and negotiating with vendors.
10 years of leadership experience in Telecommunications, Consulting, Oil and Gas or other capital project related industries.
5 years of people (direct report responsibilities for FTEs, performance evaluations, career management, etc) and/or vendor management (RFx, contract negotiations, scope management, etc).
Travel - up to 25%

It’s preferred if you have:

PMP certification, MBA, or advanced degree.
5 years of experience with fiber network deployments, including experience with constructing new outside and inside plant fiber infrastructure, and 5 years of experience with FTTH infrastructure.
Familiar with GIS (Geographic Information Systems) and database management including AutoCAD, ESRI, and/or shape file functionality.
Knowledge of network drawings, route maps and scopes of work and interpreting fiber test results and auditing projects for compliance with scopes of work.
Experience in operational improvement and process/workflow development.
Excellent analytical, financial skills and communication skills.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $136,000 - $149,600 + bonus + benefits. As pay varies by location, your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your targeted location during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Location: Austin, United States of America

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure.

Position Summary

Austin, Hybrid

As a Technical Project Manager
for the Identity and Biometrics Solutions team, you will deliver solutions that meet external customer requirements and Thales’ commitments.

The Technical Project Manager manages and coordinates internal (Control Account Managers, Work Package Managers, developers, engineers, etc.) and external (customers, suppliers, sub-contractors, partners, etc.) dedicated teams by involving the following associated teams: Sales, finance, contract management, etc.

In this role, you will direct the project activities (including those relating to risks & opportunities) to ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, satisfy technical requirements, and meet customer expectations. This responsibility is exercised from signature of the contract through to the project completion period in terms of organization, time frame, workload, budget, etc.

The Identity and Biometrics Solutions team is responsible for the design and development of highly innovative components and products, from desktop applications integrating various hardware (biometric devices integration) to high performance server applications, including issuance of official documents in a very secure environment (PKI, encryption, cryptography), and leading the transformation to Digital Driver’s Licenses.

Regulatory Compliance Requirements

Must have U.S. Citizenship in order to obtain the post-hire Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Clearance from the Federal Bureau of Investigation and must be able to obtain post-hire clearance from the Committee on Foreign Investments in the U.S. (CFIUS) and Department of Justice.

The Opportunity with McKinstry

We are currently seeking a Program Manager to join our team as a member of our growing South Technical Services division. McKinstry has a unique perspective on the life of a building, and our Technical Services suite of owner-direct offerings helps our clients make good decisions that will improve the efficiency, comfort and lifespan of the building.

jobs.title: Security Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are 🌍

We're IAG Loyalty - one organisation creating more rewarding ways to travel. Home to Avios, the global loyalty currency, we help millions of members collect and spend rewards across travel, retail and financial services.

We're transforming our technology landscape, investing in modern platforms and strengthening our cyber security capability to support our ambitious growth plans. It's an exciting time to join us as we continue to build a resilient, secure and customer-focused business.

The opportunity ✨

We're looking for a Security Operations Manager to play a key role in developing and maturing our Security Operations capability.

Working at the heart of our Cyber Security team, you'll act as the bridge between Security Engineering and Security Operations across IAG Group and our operating companies. You'll combine technical expertise with operational leadership to improve monitoring, strengthen threat detection, optimise security tooling and lead the response to security incidents.

This is a hands-on role where you'll have genuine influence over how Security Operations evolves. You'll shape the roadmap, improve operational resilience and ensure our security capabilities continue to develop as our technology landscape grows.

If you're passionate about building better security operations, enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to make a visible impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing 🚀

You'll lead the continual improvement of our Security Operations capability, working closely with Security Engineering, technology teams and third-party partners to strengthen monitoring, detection and incident response across the business.

You'll own the end-to-end incident management lifecycle, coordinating responses to security incidents, driving investigations, facilitating lessons learned and ensuring improvement actions are delivered. Alongside this, you'll configure and optimise SIEM, threat protection and case management platforms, developing new detection rules, alerts and automation to improve our ability to identify and respond to emerging threats.

You'll build and maintain operational playbooks and runbooks, helping establish consistent ways of working across internal teams and managed service providers. You'll also produce meaningful KPIs and reporting, using operational data to identify trends, improve service performance and demonstrate the effectiveness of our security controls.

Working collaboratively across technology, engineering and business teams, you'll support security testing, assurance activities and resilience exercises, helping ensure our operational security capability continues to evolve in line with business priorities and regulatory expectations.

What We Need From You ⚡

Strong experience working within Security Operations, Cyber Defence or Incident Response in a complex enterprise environment
Proven experience managing the end-to-end security incident management lifecycle
Hands-on experience configuring and administering SIEM, threat protection, logging and case management platforms
Experience developing threat detection use cases, alerts, dashboards and operational reporting
Strong understanding of security monitoring, investigation, triage, containment, recovery and continuous improvement
Experience developing operational playbooks, runbooks and standard operating procedures
Experience working closely with Security Engineering teams to improve operational capabilities
Ability to collaborate with suppliers, technology teams and stakeholders across the business
Experience developing KPIs, operational reporting and service metrics
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical information for different audiences
Good understanding of security governance, operational resilience and regulatory requirements

Desirable

Experience supporting Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery activities
Experience working with outsourced Security Operations Centres or Managed Security Service Providers
Familiarity with Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike or similar enterprise security platforms
Experience automating security operations using scripting or SOAR technologies

We might not be right for you if...

You prefer working within a narrow technical specialism rather than owning security operations end-to-end.
You enjoy maintaining existing processes more than improving and evolving them.
You prefer working independently rather than collaborating across engineering, operations and business teams.

If you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

The Blend 📍

This role will work as part of our Loyalty Division and is based from our London office.

We call our approach to hybrid working The Blend — it's about giving you the flexibility to choose where you do your best work while staying connected with your team and the wider business.

You'll typically spend at least two days each week in the office, with the remainder working remotely. There may also be occasions where you'll work from other IAG or partner locations depending on business needs.

Diversity and Inclusion

Our vision is to create a more rewarding world of travel and experiences. Delivering that requires diverse thinking and inclusive leadership.

We are committed to building a workplace where people feel they belong and are valued for their perspective. Inclusion drives better decisions, stronger performance and more innovative outcomes.

We actively encourage applications from people with different experiences and backgrounds, and are committed to ensuring our recruitment process is fair, inclusive and accessible.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Lead Information Security Operations Analyst

Overview

This is an exciting position for a Lead Threat Intelligence Analyst to join Vocalink’s dedicated Threat Intelligence function. You will be play an integral leading role in the Vocalink Threat Intelligence Team, working closely with the SOC and internal security teams to deliver actionable intelligence. You will support a diverse range of customers and contribute to key initiatives such as threat hunting, vulnerability management, and insider threat detection.

Collaboration is at the heart of this position. You will work alongside Mastercard’s global threat intelligence capabilities and engage proactively with a wide network of stakeholders, including vendors, industry groups, our customers, and government organisations.

This is a unique chance to help shape and grow a fast-evolving threat intelligence capability that serves Vocalink and its customers. If you are passionate about cyber security and eager to make an impact, this role offers an exciting platform to develop your leadership expertise and to help to grow and mature a threat intelligence function in a critical national infrastructure provider.

Role

Lead the day-to-day operations of the threat intelligence function within the Vocalink Security Operations Centre, setting the strategy for proactive monitoring and alerting to help protect Vocalink assets and identify emerging threats.

Deliver briefings and regular engagements with our customers and partners across the business.

Prepare and QC intelligence reports for teams across the wider security function, including the SOC, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Insider Threat and Physical Security, highlighting emerging threats and critical vulnerabilities.

Collaborate with Mastercard’s global threat intelligence team, supporting services that leverage Mastercard’s scale and capabilities.

Optimise reporting through our threat intelligence platform by working with vendors and internal teams to deliver high quality curated feeds which enable effective threat hunting and remediation.

Engage with vendors, industry groups, and government partners to build and maintain strong intelligence-sharing relationships.

Communicate findings clearly and promptly to internal stakeholders, ensuring accuracy and completeness.

Maintain and improve intelligence tooling, working with vendors and users to ensure the tools operate effectively.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Operations Analyst

Location: [Chicago, IL / Hybrid]

Company: Power Kiosk

Role Overview

This role reports to the Operations Lead. This may be the most challenging job you have ever taken on. You will be asked to do more in less time than you think is possible, often with limited direction. You will need to create order from chaos, hold competing ideas in your mind at once, and develop practical ways to identify and solve real-world business problems. In short: figure it out and get it done. 

If you succeed in this role, your perceived ceiling will be shattered. You will discover that you are capable of more than you thought: more discipline, more output, more ownership, & more confidence. That kind of confidence changes how you approach work, leadership, and life. If that sounds overwhelming, this may not be the right role or company for you. But if it has your full attention, keep reading. You may be exactly who we are looking for. 

What We’re Looking For

Care for the Greater Purpose | You care deeply about the success of the team and the company. You want your work to matter, and you want to be part of something bigger than yourself. 
Pain of Inefficiency | You notice inefficiency everywhere. When something is being done the hard way, it bothers you. You naturally look for cleaner, faster, smarter ways to get things done. 
Root-Cause Problem Solving | You are not satisfied with temporary fixes. You look for the real source of the problem and work to eliminate it. While others push harder, you remove the roadblocks that make progress easier. 
Love When Things Work Just Right | Recognition and rewards matter, but what really drives you is the feeling of seeing something work exactly the way it should. You enjoy building systems that make people more effective. 
Self-Aware Learner | You know what you know, and you know what you do not know. You learn quickly, separate what matters from what does not, and focus on the vital few things that move the work forward. 
Great Listener and Question Framer | You listen carefully, hear what is said and unsaid, and ask strong follow-up questions. You understand that the right question is often more valuable than a quick answer. 
Reliability and Accountability | When you take ownership of something, it gets done and done well. You do not need constant follow-up, and you help create accountability for others around you. 

About Power Kiosk

Power Kiosk is a technology platform transforming energy procurement and management for enterprises, energy advisors, and suppliers. Our platform streamlines energy purchasing, pricing, enrollment, and performance reporting workflows, bringing clarity, control, and efficiency to complex energy decisions. 

What you will be doing

Power Kiosk is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Operations Analyst to support and optimize the day-to-day operations of our growing energy technology platform. In this role, you will manage critical operational processes across the customer and contract lifecycle, partner with Sales, Account Management, Operations, and Product teams, and ensure a seamless experience for customers, advisors, brokers, and suppliers. 

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, and customer-focused, with a passion for process improvement and operational excellence. You will play a key role in supporting customer onboarding, maintaining operational data and reporting, validating business workflows, and identifying opportunities to streamline operations through automation, documentation, and continuous improvement. 

Key Responsibilities

Support the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and enrollments through ongoing account support. 
Support the full contract lifecycle, including pre-sale, in-sale, and post-sale operations/needs. 
Partner with Sales and Account Managers on customer onboarding and activation support. 
Coordinate with platform participants (e.g., brokers, suppliers, and internal teams) to resolve operational and customer issues. 
Ensure compliance with internal policies and customer requirements. 
Prepare operational documentation, workflow-related documents (e.g., agreements, DocuSign packages, authorization forms, etc.),, and other business documents. 
Maintain, action, and analyze operational data, reporting, dashboard insights, KPIs, pricing trackers, and business metrics. 
Execute business-focused platform testing, validate workflows, and document product issues. 
Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation, documentation, and operational best practices. 

Qualifications

Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing tasks. 
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

jobs.title: AI Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
About the role:

Apt Companies is an IT staffing and workforce solutions firm. Over the past year we've built a real internal tech stack: a custom platform called Apt Command, integrations into our ATS and our data providers, and a growing pile of automations across operations, sales, and marketing. One person built all of it. He isn't a software engineer, and we're not hiring one now.

We have more ideas in flight than hands to finish them. Projects get built to eighty percent and then parked when something urgent shows up. Reports still get assembled by hand. Recruiters still retype data that already lives in another system. And the tooling in this space changes every few weeks, so keeping current with it is close to a job by itself. You'd own that backlog. Take projects from idea to shipped to actually in use, and keep hunting for the automations that bring in revenue rather than the ones that only save time. You'll report to our Director of Operations, learn the staffing business from the inside, and use AI coding tools the way an analyst uses Excel.

What you'll do:

First 90 days

Sit with recruiting, delivery, sales, and back office. Learn how staffing works end to end, req through submittal through placement through invoice, and find where the manual steps actually are rather than where we assume they are
Get fluent in our stack: Apt Command, our ATS and its integrations, our data providers, our automation tooling
Pick two or three recurring reports or manual workflows and rebuild them so they run themselves
Ship something people use in your first month, even if it's small

Months 3 to 9

Own the internal AI and automation roadmap: intake requests from the business, size them, sequence them, drive them to done
Finish the projects sitting at eighty percent. A good chunk of this job is exactly that, and we'd rather say so now than have you find out in month two
Build and extend internal tooling: reporting, dashboards, data hygiene, workflow automation
Build agent workflows that support outbound work: research, enrichment, list building, content production, sequencing
Train the team on what you build and check whether they're using it. Adoption is how we'll judge the role, not how much got shipped

Months 9 and on

Keep up with the market: AI tooling, agent frameworks, what other staffing firms are and are not doing. Come back with proposals rather than links
Find automation that generates revenue: earlier signal on hiring demand, better candidate matching, higher submittal quality, more outreach at the same headcount
Build validated write-back paths so data entered once lands correctly in the system of record
Take on more scope as you earn it. This role should grow into leading internal AI and automation for the firm

What we're looking for:

Required

Some real experience owning a messy process. Operations, recruiting or staffing ops, sales ops, analytics, marketing ops, project management, back office. Anywhere things broke and you were the one who fixed them. We're not counting years
Advanced with spreadsheets, well past VLOOKUP. You've built things in Excel or Sheets that other people depend on
Something you built. A working tool, a live automation, a bot, a side project, a process you rebuilt. Built at work or built at home, we don't care which. We'll ask you to walk us through it in detail, including the parts that broke
Hands-on time in an AI coding environment like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Not just chatting with a model, actually building with one
Data sense. When a report double-counts, you can work out why. You don't need to know SQL yet
Judgment about what to build. You can tell what someone asked for apart from what they need, and you'd rather ship a rough tool people use tomorrow than a polished one in six months
A habit of finishing. Error handling, documentation, training, and follow-up are the last twenty percent, and they are the job
Self-direction. Nobody here is going to hand you a ticket queue
Enough humility to be told by a recruiter that you solved the wrong problem, and go rebuild it

Helpful, not required

SQL
Staffing, recruiting, or professional services background
Bullhorn, Salesforce, or another ATS or CRM
Workflow automation tools like n8n, Zapier, or Make
BI and dashboarding experience
APIs, webhooks, JavaScript, Python, or any coding at all, however informal

Not required

A computer science degree
Professional software development experience
A specific number of years in anything
Having written code before this year

How the process works:

Resumes are a weak filter for this role, so here is what to expect...
Apply with proof. Skip the cover letter. Send us a link, a screenshot, a short screen recording, or two paragraphs about something you built and why. This is the real first screen, and it matters more to us than your resume
Intro call. Your background and what you've built
Show us something. Screen share a tool, automation, or process you built with AI. We want to see how you worked through it, where it broke, and how you figured out the fix
Working session, onsite. We'll give you a real Apt problem and a few hours. Use whatever tools you normally use. We're watching how you break down something unfamiliar, not whether you finish
Conversation with leadership. Judgment, communication, and why you want the job

Guardrails

We want you moving fast, and AI-generated code still needs verification. So a few rules:
Read-only integrations before write access
No production credentials in code, and no shared logins
Candidate and client data is confidential and in places regulated. It doesn't go into unapproved tools and it doesn't leave our systems
Anything touching payroll, invoicing, or client-facing reporting gets reviewed before it goes live
Sandbox and test environments before production
Document what you build in plain language, as you build it. Someone else should be able to run it without you in the room

Who this suits

Someone who has been quietly automating their own job with AI and wants to do it full-time, with real backing and without having to ask permission. Someone who reads about this on their own time and likes finishing things.
We want you to grow here. This role should turn into leading internal AI and automation for the firm, and we'd rather build that person than go hire them.

Probably not a fit if you want a defined ticket queue, if you'd rather write strategy decks than build, if you'd rather not talk to the people who will use what you make, or if you need a senior engineer to check your work before you feel comfortable moving.

Located in Vancouver, Canada, and operating as a gateway to Fujitsu’s profound global engineering and innovation ecosystem, Fujitsu Intelligence is positioned as a digital transformation catalyst, working to grow Fujitsu’s AI and optimization business in North America and globally.

Comprised of a diverse and talented team of professionals committed to helping Fujitsu’s customers navigate an increasingly digital world, Fujitsu Intelligence believes that employee development, health and wellbeing, work-life balance, and diversity and inclusion are as important to them as being leaders in digital innovation. Position Summary

We're looking for an experienced deployment-focused technical leader to join Fujitsu's AI and optimization team. This role is responsible for maximizing the impact and scalability of customer deployments by shaping how solutions are deployed—not only what is built.

As a Deployment Strategist, you will help define deployment patterns, engagement models, and delivery approaches that allow AI, optimization, and data-driven solutions to scale across customers and industries. You will work at the intersection of customer problem framing, pre-sales execution, technical feasibility, scope definition, and delivery risk management.

This position is within the Professional Services team, where you will work alongside forward deployed engineers, data scientists, engineers, software developers, and sales stakeholders to ensure customer engagements are feasible, well-scoped, and aligned to measurable business value.

Define deployment patterns, archetypes, and engagement models that enable repeatable, scalable delivery across customers and use cases

Draft project scopes, delivery plans, assumptions, dependencies, and resource estimates in collaboration with sales and delivery teams
Build proofs-of-concept, technical demos, and deployment narratives in partnership with field deployment engineers and technical teams
Help customers articulate goals, success metrics, constraints, and operating assumptions early in the engagement lifecycle
Push back constructively on ill-defined, low-leverage, or misaligned requests and reframe them around business value
Anticipate technical, organizational, and delivery risks, and ensure deployment scope remains aligned to customer outcomes

Basic Qualifications

We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed in our job description. However, we value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we believe in hiring individuals who bring unique strengths to our team. If you are passionate about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply even if your qualifications do not perfectly align with the requirements. You may be the ideal candidate for this or other opportunities within our organization. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and look forward to learning more about what you can contribute.

Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in engineering, computer science, data science, operations research, business, or a related quantitative or technical field
Experience in consulting, solution delivery, technical pre-sales, deployment strategy, product implementation, or a comparable client-facing technical role

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical trade-offs, deployment risks, and business implications to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience assessing technical feasibility, delivery complexity, and implementation risk for customer-facing solutions
Organized, articulate, and able to manage multiple customer engagements, deliverables, and internal stakeholders at any given time

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Palantir Foundry or a comparable deployment, data, analytics, or application development platform

Experience contributing to statements of work, project plans, estimates, delivery assumptions, or commercial proposals
Experience working with field deployment engineers, product teams, sales teams, or solution architects to move from customer need to executable delivery plan
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments and applying sound judgment to balance customization, standardization, and productization

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Risk Adjustment Analyst II supports the organization’s Medicare Advantage (MA) and Affordable Care Act (ACA) risk adjustment programs by managing data submissions, developing reporting, and delivering actionable analytics. This role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of encounter and risk score data, including RAF (MA) and PLRS (ACA) reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Manage Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) encounter submissions and ACA data processes including EDGE/PLRS reporting.
Perform data validation, reconciliation, and root cause analysis to identify and resolve variances between submitted data and CMS-accepted data.
Analyze submission errors, response files, and rejection trends to improve data quality and acceptance rates.
Develop and maintain risk score reporting, key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards such as risk adjustment factor (RAF), plan liability risk score (PLRS), enrollment, drivers, population trends.
Prepare monthly production and performance reports across retrieval, coding, and vendor operations.
Support retrospective chart reviews and risk adjustment data validation (RADV) activities, including chase list development.
Write complex SQL queries and integrate data across claims, encounters, enrollment, pharmacy, and vendor sources.
Partner with vendors and internal teams to improve data quality, reporting, and operational performance.
Analyze CMS response files such as MAO-004 and monthly membership reports (MMR); ensure conditions are being captured, reported accurately and accepted by CMS’s data systems; identify trends in risk scores, enrollment, population segments and identify new initiative opportunities.
Mentor and support junior analysts to promote consistency and best practices across the team.
Translate data into actionable business insights and proactively recommend process improvements.
Serve as a subject matter resource for risk adjustment data, submissions, and reporting.
Perform other job-related duties as required or assigned.

Qualifications

Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques to the analysis of healthcare and risk adjustment data (MA and ACA).
Demonstrated ability to independently manage work, prioritize competing demands, and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision.
Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present risk adjustment data, reporting insights, and findings to diverse audiences.
Demonstrated knowledge of programming, including writing, modifying, and optimizing queries (SQL preferred).
Demonstrated knowledge of healthcare data, including claims, encounters, enrollment, and provider data, with a strong understanding of risk adjustment processes and data flows.
Working knowledge of Medicare Advantage and/or ACA risk adjustment methodologies, including HCC models, encounter submissions, and/or EDGE/PLRS reporting processes.
Experience analyzing CMS and/or ACA response files, submission errors, and reconciliation outputs preferred.
Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel preferred.
Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to perform root cause analysis and data validation.
Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree required. Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred. Master’s degree is a plus.
Demonstrated use of analytical tools such as SAS or SQL.
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other similar visualization tools preferred.
A minimum of three years of Health Data analysis experience required. Two or more years of risk adjustment experience preferred.

Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland is part of the nation’s central bank and we’ve provided many opportunities for professional growth during our history.
